segments.sn35.4:1.4: Yadanattā taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.sn35.4:1.5: Saddā … gandhā … rasā … phoṭṭhabbā … dhammā aniccā.
segments.sn35.4:1.12: Yadanattā taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.sn35.4:1.13: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpesupi nibbindati, saddesupi nibbindati, gandhesupi nibbindati, rasesupi nibbindati, phoṭṭhabbesupi nibbindati, dhammesupi nibbindati.
segments.sn35.4:1.14: Nibbindaṃ virajjati; virāgā vimuccati; vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
segments.sn35.4:1.15: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.

lines: Idampi bāhiresu chasu āyatanesu tilakkhaṇaṃ dassetvā kathite bujjhanakānaṃ vasena vuttaṃ.
Pañcame chaṭṭhe ca dutiyatatiyesu vuttasadisova nayo.
